name: Aigert-Serve
description: Aigert to Serve. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
utilities: STF Aigert Fjällstuga / Aigert Mountain Cabin (lodging)
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: STF gives 19 km / 5-7 h; Naturkartan gives 20.0 km / 7-9 h; geometry computes about 19.2-19.4 km; route apps cluster around 19-20.6 km with elapsed times up to about 8 hours.
STF stage/overview uses short Serve, while Naturkartan/Vindelfjällen often use Servestugan. Facility is STF Serve Fjällstuga.

Naturkartan/API gives Juovatvaretje rastskydd at 65.926434,15.938271, while Naturvårdsverket Anordningar / OSM / toilet alignment supports about 65.923190,15.954065. Names vary between Juovatvaretje and Juovvatjåhkka.

Some older/tourism sources imply Serve provisions, but current STF stage says no shop at Serve and lists shop huts as Aigert, Tärnasjö and Viterskalet. Third-party field lane noted shop ended in 2020.
Some non-official/tourism mentions imply a sauna, but no current STF/Naturkartan/Anordningar/OSM evidence found.
Field blogs may call Juovatvaretje/Juovvatjåhkka and Vuomatjåhkka/Matsen cabins/huts, but official Naturkartan classifies them as rest/emergency shelters.
OSM has emergency-phone-like tags on mid-shelter nodes, but Naturkartan describes emergency boxes, not help phones, and Anordningar has no help-phone records for these shelters.
